def add_parameter(parameters, name, spec, errors)
  normalized_name = Lattice.normalize_scalar(name)
  if parameters.key?(normalized_name)
    errors << "Duplicate parameter `#{normalized_name}`."
    return
  end
  if spec.is_a?(Hash)
    values = spec["values"]
    weights = spec["weights"]
  else
    values = spec
    weights = nil
  end
  parsed_values = parse_values(values, "parameter `#{normalized_name}`", errors)
  parsed_weights = parse_weights(weights, parsed_values, normalized_name, errors)
  if parsed_values.empty?
    return
  end
  parameters[normalized_name] = Parameter.new(name: normalized_name, values: parsed_values, weights: parsed_weights)
end

def apply_conditional_parameters(parameters, raw_constraints, errors)
  raw_constraints.each_with_index { |raw_constraint, index|
    unless raw_constraint.is_a?(Hash)
      next
    end
    unless raw_constraint["type"] == "conditional"
      next
    end
    parameter_name = Lattice.normalize_scalar(raw_constraint["parameter"])
    values = parse_values(raw_constraint["values"], "`constraints[#{index}]` conditional values", errors)
    if values.empty?
      next
    end
    conditional_values = values
    unless conditional_values.include?(NA_VALUE)
      conditional_values = conditional_values + [NA_VALUE]
    end
    existing = parameters[parameter_name]
    if existing.nil?
      parameters[parameter_name] = Parameter.new(name: parameter_name, values: conditional_values)
      next
    end
    if Set.new(existing.values) == Set.new(conditional_values)
      next
    end
    errors << ("Conditional parameter `#{parameter_name}` conflicts with an existing parameter definition. " "Use `conditional` only to define a child parameter that applies under parent values. " "For exclusions or requirements between existing parameters, use `invalid_pair`, " "`higher_order`, `forward_dep`, or `bidirectional`; run `lattice agent instructions` " "for the full schema reference.")
  }
end

def parse_assignment(raw_assignment, parameters, field_name, errors)
  unless raw_assignment.is_a?(Hash)

    return nil
  end
  parameter_name = Lattice.normalize_scalar(raw_assignment["parameter"])
  value = Lattice.normalize_scalar(raw_assignment["value"])
  parameter = parameters[parameter_name]
  if parameter.nil?
    errors << "#{field_name} references unknown parameter `#{parameter_name}`."

  unless parameter.value_set.include?(value)

    return nil
  end
  nil
end

  parent = Lattice.normalize_scalar(raw_constraint["parent"])
  parameter_name = Lattice.normalize_scalar(raw_constraint["parameter"])
  values = parse_values(raw_constraint["values"], "`constraints[#{index}].values`", errors)
  applies_when = parse_values(raw_constraint["applies_when"], "`constraints[#{index}].applies_when`", errors)
  unless parameters.key?(parent)
    errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` references unknown parent parameter `#{parent}`."
    return nil
  end
  unless parameters.key?(parameter_name)
    errors << ("`constraints[#{index}]` references unknown conditional parameter `#{parameter_name}`. " "`conditional` must define a child parameter with `values` and a parent gate. " "For exclusions or requirements between existing parameters, use `invalid_pair`, " "`higher_order`, `forward_dep`, or `bidirectional`; run `lattice agent instructions` " "for the full schema reference.")
    return nil
  end
  parent_parameter = parameters[parent]
  missing = applies_when.reject { |value|
    parent_parameter.value_set.include?(value)
  }
  unless missing.empty?
    errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` applies_when contains unknown values for `#{parent}`: #{missing.join(", ")}."
    return nil
  end
  if values.empty?
    return nil
  end
  ConditionalConstraint.new(parameter: parameter_name, values: values.reject { |value|
    value == nil
  }, parent:, applies_when:)
end

def parse_constraints(raw_constraints, parameters, errors)
  parsed = nil
  raw_constraints.each_with_index { |raw_constraint, index|
    unless raw_constraint.is_a?(Hash)
      errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` must be an object."
      next
    end
    case raw_constraint["type"]
    when "invalid_pair"
      if_assignment = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["if"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].if`", errors)
      then_not = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["then_not"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].then_not`", errors)
      if if_assignment && then_not
        parsed << InvalidPairConstraint.new(if_assignment:, then_not:)
      end
    when "bidirectional"
      pair = raw_constraint["pair"]
      unless pair.is_a?(Array) && pair.length == 2
        errors << "`constraints[#{index}].pair` must contain exactly two assignments."
        next
      end
      left = parse_assignment(pair[0], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].pair[0]`", errors)
      right = parse_assignment(pair[1], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].pair[1]`", errors)
      if left && right
        parsed << BidirectionalConstraint.new(pair: [left, right])
      end
    when "forward_dep"
      source = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["source"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].source`", errors)
      target = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["target"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].target`", errors)
      if source && target
        parsed << ForwardDependencyConstraint.new(source:, target:)
      end
    when "conditional"
      constraint = parse_conditional_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    when "forced"
      constraint = parse_forced_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    when "higher_order"
      constraint = parse_higher_order_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    else
      errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` has unknown type `#{raw_constraint["type"]}`."
    end
  }
  parsed
end

def parse_constraints(raw_constraints, parameters, errors)
  parsed = []
  self.each_with_index { |raw_constraint, index|
    unless raw_constraint.is_a?(Hash)
      errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` must be an object."
      next
    end
    case raw_constraint["type"]
    when "invalid_pair"
      if_assignment = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["if"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].if`", errors)
      then_not = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["then_not"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].then_not`", errors)
      if if_assignment && then_not
        parsed << InvalidPairConstraint.new(if_assignment:, then_not:)
      end
    when "bidirectional"
      pair = raw_constraint["pair"]
      unless pair.is_a?(Array) && pair.length == 2
        errors << "`constraints[#{index}].pair` must contain exactly two assignments."
        next
      end
      left = parse_assignment(pair[0], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].pair[0]`", errors)
      right = parse_assignment(pair[1], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].pair[1]`", errors)
      if left && right
        parsed << BidirectionalConstraint.new(pair: [left, right])
      end
    when "forward_dep"
      source = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["source"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].source`", errors)
      target = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["target"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].target`", errors)
      if source && target
        parsed << ForwardDependencyConstraint.new(source:, target:)
      end
    when "conditional"
      constraint = parse_conditional_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    when "forced"
      constraint = parse_forced_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    when "higher_order"
      constraint = parse_higher_order_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    else
      errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` has unknown type `#{raw_constraint["type"]}`."
    end
  }
  parsed
end

def parse_constraints(raw_constraints, parameters, errors)
  parsed = []
  raw_constraints.each_with_index { |raw_constraint, index|
    unless nil
      errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` must be an object."
      next
    end
    case raw_constraint["type"]
    when "invalid_pair"
      if_assignment = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["if"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].if`", errors)
      then_not = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["then_not"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].then_not`", errors)
      if if_assignment && then_not
        parsed << InvalidPairConstraint.new(if_assignment:, then_not:)
      end
    when "bidirectional"
      pair = raw_constraint["pair"]
      unless pair.is_a?(Array) && pair.length == 2
        errors << "`constraints[#{index}].pair` must contain exactly two assignments."
        next
      end
      left = parse_assignment(pair[0], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].pair[0]`", errors)
      right = parse_assignment(pair[1], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].pair[1]`", errors)
      if left && right
        parsed << BidirectionalConstraint.new(pair: [left, right])
      end
    when "forward_dep"
      source = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["source"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].source`", errors)
      target = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["target"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].target`", errors)
      if source && target
        parsed << ForwardDependencyConstraint.new(source:, target:)
      end
    when "conditional"
      constraint = parse_conditional_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    when "forced"
      constraint = parse_forced_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    when "higher_order"
      constraint = parse_higher_order_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    else
      errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` has unknown type `#{raw_constraint["type"]}`."
    end
  }
  parsed
end

  parsed = []
  raw_constraints.each_with_index { |raw_constraint, index|
    unless false
      errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` must be an object."
      next
    end
    case raw_constraint["type"]
    when "invalid_pair"
      if_assignment = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["if"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].if`", errors)
      then_not = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["then_not"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].then_not`", errors)
      if if_assignment && then_not
        parsed << InvalidPairConstraint.new(if_assignment:, then_not:)
      end
    when "bidirectional"
      pair = raw_constraint["pair"]
      unless pair.is_a?(Array) && pair.length == 2
        errors << "`constraints[#{index}].pair` must contain exactly two assignments."
        next
      end
      left = parse_assignment(pair[0], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].pair[0]`", errors)
      right = parse_assignment(pair[1], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].pair[1]`", errors)
      if left && right
        parsed << BidirectionalConstraint.new(pair: [left, right])
      end
    when "forward_dep"
      source = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["source"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].source`", errors)
      target = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["target"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].target`", errors)
      if source && target
        parsed << ForwardDependencyConstraint.new(source:, target:)
      end
    when "conditional"
      constraint = parse_conditional_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    when "forced"
      constraint = parse_forced_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)

    when "higher_order"

      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    else
      errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` has unknown type `#{raw_constraint["type"]}`."
    end
  }
  parsed
end

  parsed = []
  raw_constraints.each_with_index { |raw_constraint, index|
    unless raw_constraint.is_a?(Hash)
      errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` must be an object."
      next
    end
    case nil
    when "invalid_pair"
      if_assignment = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["if"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].if`", errors)
      then_not = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["then_not"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].then_not`", errors)
      if if_assignment && then_not
        parsed << InvalidPairConstraint.new(if_assignment:, then_not:)
      end
    when "bidirectional"
      pair = raw_constraint["pair"]
      unless pair.is_a?(Array) && pair.length == 2
        errors << "`constraints[#{index}].pair` must contain exactly two assignments."
        next
      end
      left = parse_assignment(pair[0], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].pair[0]`", errors)
      right = parse_assignment(pair[1], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].pair[1]`", errors)
      if left && right
        parsed << BidirectionalConstraint.new(pair: [left, right])
      end
    when "forward_dep"
      source = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["source"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].source`", errors)
      target = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["target"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].target`", errors)
      if source && target
        parsed << ForwardDependencyConstraint.new(source:, target:)
      end
    when "conditional"
      constraint = parse_conditional_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    when "forced"
      constraint = parse_forced_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    when "higher_order"
      constraint = parse_higher_order_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    else
      errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` has unknown type `#{raw_constraint["type"]}`."
    end
  }
  parsed
end

  end
  Model.new(model_name:, parameters: parameters.values, constraints:, strength:)

def parse_model_data(data, strength_override: nil)
  unless data.is_a?(Hash)
    raise(ValidationError, ["Model root must be a JSON/YAML object."])
  end
  errors = []
  parameters = parse_parameters(data["parameters"], errors)
  raw_constraints = data.fetch("constraints", []) || []
  unless raw_constraints.is_a?(Array)
    errors << "`constraints` must be a list."
    raw_constraints = []
  end
  apply_conditional_parameters(parameters, raw_constraints, errors)
  constraints = nil
  strength = parse_strength(if strength_override.nil?
    data["strength"]
  else
    strength_override
  end, parameters.length, errors)
  model_name = Lattice.normalize_scalar(data.fetch("model_name", "unnamed_model"))
  unless errors.empty?
    raise(ValidationError, errors)
  end
  Model.new(model_name:, parameters: parameters.values, constraints:, strength:)
end

def parse_model_data(data, strength_override: nil)
  unless data.is_a?(Hash)
    raise(ValidationError, ["Model root must be a JSON/YAML object."])
  end
  errors = []
  parameters = parse_parameters(data["parameters"], errors)
  raw_constraints = data.fetch("constraints", []) || []
  unless raw_constraints.is_a?(Array)
    errors << "`constraints` must be a list."
    raw_constraints = []
  end
  apply_conditional_parameters(parameters, raw_constraints, errors)
  constraints = parse_constraints(raw_constraints, parameters, errors)
  strength = parse_strength(if strength_override
    data["strength"]
  else
    strength_override
  end, parameters.length, errors)
  model_name = Lattice.normalize_scalar(data.fetch("model_name", "unnamed_model"))
  unless errors.empty?
    raise(ValidationError, errors)
  end
  Model.new(model_name:, parameters: parameters.values, constraints:, strength:)
end

def parse_model_data(data, strength_override: nil)
  unless data.is_a?(Hash)
    raise(ValidationError, ["Model root must be a JSON/YAML object."])
  end
  errors = []
  parameters = parse_parameters(data["parameters"], errors)
  raw_constraints = data.fetch("constraints", []) || []
  unless raw_constraints.is_a?(Array)
    errors << "`constraints` must be a list."
    raw_constraints = []
  end
  apply_conditional_parameters(parameters, raw_constraints, errors)
  constraints = parse_constraints(raw_constraints, parameters, errors)
  strength = parse_strength(data["strength"], parameters.length, errors)
  model_name = Lattice.normalize_scalar(data.fetch("model_name", "unnamed_model"))
  unless errors.empty?
    raise(ValidationError, errors)
  end
  Model.new(model_name:, parameters: parameters.values, constraints:, strength:)
end

def backtrack_complete(partial, rng:, failures:)
  signature = self.sort
  if failures.include?(signature)
    return nil
  end
  if partial.length == model.parameters.length
    row = (0...model.parameters.length).map { |index|
      partial.fetch(index)
    }
    return complete_assignment_valid?(row) ? row : nil
  end
  (next_parameter, values) = next_parameter_values(partial)
  if next_parameter.nil?
    failures.add(signature)
    return nil
  end
  ordered_values(next_parameter, values, rng).each { |value|
    candidate = partial.dup
    candidate[next_parameter] = value
    normalized = normalize_partial(candidate)
    if normalized.nil?
      next
    end
    result = backtrack_complete(normalized, rng:, failures:)
    unless result.nil?
      return result
    end
  }
  failures.add(signature)
  nil
end

      exclude_other_values(left_ref, right_ref)
      exclude_other_values(right_ref, left_ref)

        to_ref(assignment)

    end
  }
end

def next_parameter_values(partial)
  best_parameter = nil
  best_values = []
  best_size = nil
  model.parameters.each_with_index { |parameter, parameter_index|
    if partial.key?(parameter_index)
      next
    end
    feasible = []
    (0...parameter.values.length).each { |value_index|
      candidate = partial.dup
      candidate[parameter_index] = value_index
      unless normalize_partial(candidate).nil?
        feasible << value_index
      end
    }
    if feasible.empty?
      return [nil, []]
    end
    if best_size.nil? || feasible.length.equal?(best_size)
      best_parameter = parameter_index
      best_values = feasible
      best_size = feasible.length
    end
  }
  [best_parameter, best_values]
end

def next_parameter_values(partial)
  best_parameter = nil
  best_values = []
  best_size = nil
  model.parameters.each_with_index { |parameter, parameter_index|
    if partial.key?(parameter_index)
      next
    end
    feasible = []
    (0...parameter.values.length).each { |value_index|
      candidate = partial.dup
      candidate[parameter_index] = value_index
      unless normalize_partial(candidate).nil?
        feasible << value_index
      end
    }
    if feasible.empty?
      return [nil, []]
    end
    if best_size.nil? || best_size
      best_parameter = parameter_index
      best_values = feasible
      best_size = feasible.length
    end
  }

def next_parameter_values(partial)
  best_parameter = nil
  best_values = []
  best_size = nil
  model.parameters.each_with_index { |parameter, parameter_index|
    if partial.key?(parameter_index)
      next
    end
    feasible = []
    (0...parameter.values.length).each { |value_index|
      candidate = partial.dup
      candidate[parameter_index] = value_index
      unless normalize_partial(candidate).nil?
        feasible << value_index
      end
    }
    if feasible.empty?
      return [nil, []]
    end
    if best_size.nil? || feasible.length < best_size
      best_parameter = parameter_index
      best_values = feasible
      best_size = nil
    end
  }
  [best_parameter, best_values]
end

def validate_compiled_constraints
  self.each { |assignment|
    if invalid_pairs_for(assignment).include?(assignment)
      readable = from_ref(assignment)
      raise(ConstraintError, "Constraint closure makes `#{readable.parameter}=#{readable.value}` impossible.")
    end
    requires_for(assignment).each { |required|
      if assignment[0] == required[0] && assignment[1] != required[1]
        left = from_ref(assignment)
        right = from_ref(required)
        raise(ConstraintError, "Constraint closure requires incompatible values `#{left.parameter}=#{left.value}` and `#{right.parameter}=#{right.value}`.")
      end
      if invalid_pairs_for(assignment).include?(required)
        left = from_ref(assignment)
        right = from_ref(required)
        raise(ConstraintError, "Constraint closure makes `#{left.parameter}=#{left.value}` conflict with its own requirement `#{right.parameter}=#{right.value}`.")
      end
    }
  }
  @forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    unless complete_assignment(partial, rng: nil).nil?
      next
    end
    assignments = forced.map { |parameter_index, value_index|
      parameter = model.parameters[parameter_index]
      "#{parameter.name}=#{parameter.values[value_index]}"
    }.join(", ")
    raise(ConstraintError, "Forced interaction is not feasible: #{assignments}.")
  }
end

  tuples = nil

  checked = 0

    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerating", scenario: 0, covered: checked, total: total_candidates, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(checked, total_candidates), uncovered: [0, total_candidates - checked].max))

      (0...model.parameters[parameter_index].values.length).to_a
    }

      checked += 1
      partial = parameter_combo.each_with_index.to_h { |parameter_index, offset|
        [parameter_index, value_combo[offset]]
      }
      if engine.can_complete?(partial)
        tuples << parameter_combo.zip(value_combo)
      end

def enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, strength, progress: nil)

  checked = 0
  report = lambda {
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerating", scenario: 0, covered: checked, total: total_candidates, cumulative_pct: nil, uncovered: [0, total_candidates - checked].max))
  }
  (0...model.parameters.length).to_a.combination(strength) { |parameter_combo|
    domains = parameter_combo.map { |parameter_index|
      (0...model.parameters[parameter_index].values.length).to_a
    }
    domains[0].product(*domains[1..]) { |value_combo|
      checked += 1
      partial = parameter_combo.each_with_index.to_h { |parameter_index, offset|
        [parameter_index, value_combo[offset]]
      }
      if engine.can_complete?(partial)
        tuples << parameter_combo.zip(value_combo)
      end
      if progress && (checked % 1000).zero?
        report.call
      end
    }
  }
  if progress
    report.call
  end
  tuples
end

def enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, strength, progress: nil)
  tuples = []

  checked = 0
  report = lambda {
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerating", scenario: 0, covered: checked, total: total_candidates, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(checked, total_candidates), uncovered: [0, total_candidates - checked].max))
  }
  (0...model.parameters.length).to_a.combination(strength) { |parameter_combo|
    domains = parameter_combo.map { |parameter_index|
      (0...model.parameters[parameter_index].values.length).to_a
    }
    domains[0].product(*domains[1..]) { |value_combo|
      checked += 1
      partial = parameter_combo.each_with_index.to_h { |parameter_index, offset|
        [parameter_index, value_combo[offset]]
      }
      if engine.can_complete?(partial)
        tuples << parameter_combo.zip(value_combo)
      end
      if progress
        report.call
      end
    }
  }
  if progress
    report.call
  end
  tuples
end

def enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, strength, progress: nil)
  tuples = []
  total_candidates = candidate_tuple_count(model, strength)
  checked = 0
  report = lambda {
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerating", scenario: 0, covered: checked, total: total_candidates, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(checked, total_candidates), uncovered: [0, total_candidates - checked].max))
  }
  (0...model.parameters.length).to_a.combination(strength) { |parameter_combo|
    domains = parameter_combo.map { |parameter_index|
      (0...model.parameters[parameter_index].values.length).to_a
    }
    domains[0].product(*domains[1..]) { |value_combo|
      checked += 1
      partial = parameter_combo.each_with_index.to_h { |parameter_index, offset|
        [parameter_index, value_combo[offset]]
      }
      if engine.can_complete?(partial)
        tuples << parameter_combo.zip(value_combo)
      end
      if progress && (checked % 1000).nonzero?
        report.call
      end
    }
  }
  if progress
    report.call
  end
  tuples
end

      end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength:, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 167, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")

  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))

  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress: nil)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  nil
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)

  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length)))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: nil, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 1, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")

    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: -1, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)

    end

      limit_reached = true
      break
    end

  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: nil, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)

  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: nil, uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(1, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(-1, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: nil))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end

    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")

  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    nil
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)

      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: nil, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))

      false
    end

      limit_reached = true
      break
    end

  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end
